items.title: 24.3.2 Primary, secondary aur tertiary amines ki pehchan (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 24.3.2, with Quick Check 24.3 answered (PDF 123-124). Answers need review.

blocks.text: Primary, secondary aur tertiary aliphatic amines ko nitric(III) acid (nitrous acid, HNO₂) se react kara kar pehchana aur alag kiya jata hai. Nitrous acid unstable (jaldi tootne wala) hai, is liye ise NaNO₂ aur HCl se usi waqt banaya jata hai. Primary amines nitrous acid se react kar ke diazonium salts banati hain; is amal ko diazotization kehte hain.

blocks.alt: NaNO2 + HCl se HNO2 + NaCl. Neeche: CH3-CH2-NH2 (ethanamine) + HNO2 + HCl se CH3-CH2-N(+) triple bond N Cl- (ethane diazonium chloride) + 2H2O.
blocks.caption: Ethanamine aur nitrous acid se ethane diazonium chloride (kitab ke PDF safha 123 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Secondary amines nitrous acid se react kar ke N-nitrosoamines banati hain, jo peela (yellow) tel jaisa liquid hai.

blocks.alt: CH3-CH2-NH jis ke N par CH3 hai (N-methylethanamine) + HNO2, teer ke oopar NaNO2 + HCl, se CH3-CH2-N(CH3)-NO (N-methyl-N-nitrosoethanamine) + H2O.
blocks.caption: N-methylethanamine aur nitrous acid se N-nitrosoamine (kitab ke PDF safha 124 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne secondary amine wali equation mein ‘NH – HNO₂’ chhapa hai; asal mein yeh ‘+ HNO₂’ hai, jaisa drawing mein hai. Primary amine wali equation ke neeche label ‘ethaneamine’ chhapa hai; sahi naam ethanamine hai.
Tertiary amines nitrous acid se react kar ke soluble (ghulne wala) salt banati hain.

blocks.alt: CH3-CH2-N jis par do CH3 groups hain (N,N-dimethylethanamine) + HNO2 se, square brackets mein + charge ke saath, CH3-CH2-N(CH3)2-H aur NO2- (N,N-dimethylethanammonium nitrite, ghulne wala).
blocks.caption: N,N-dimethylethanamine aur nitrous acid se ghulne wala nitrite namak (kitab ke PDF safha 124 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

items: Primary amines nitrous acid se nitrogen gas deti hain (bulbule nazar aate hain).
Secondary amines nitrous acid se peela tel jaisa liquid deti hain.

blocks.text: Tertiary amines nitrous acid se soluble nitrite salts banati hain. Reaction ka koi nishan nazar nahi aata.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teenon ko yun yaad rakhein: primary amine se diazonium salt banta hai jo aliphatic hone ki wajah se fauran toot kar N₂ gas (bulbule) deta hai; secondary amine se peela tel jaisa N-nitrosoamine banta hai; tertiary amine sirf ghulne wala nitrite salt banati hai, koi tabdeeli nazar nahi aati.

blocks.prompt: a) Phenylamine (Kb = 4.2 × 10⁻¹⁰) cyclohexylamine (Kb = 3.3 × 10⁻⁴) se taqreeban das lakh (million) guna kam basic kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Phenylamine mein nitrogen ka lone pair benzene ring par delocalised hai, is liye proton lene ke liye bohat kam milta hai. Cyclohexylamine ki ring saturated hai, is liye lone pair nitrogen par hi rehta hai aur alkyl ring electrons nitrogen ki taraf dhakelti hai.

blocks.prompt: b) Ethanamine aur propan-2-amine mein se kaun zyada basic hai? Wajah batayein.
blocks.explanation: Kitab ke usool ke mutabiq propan-2-amine thori zyada basic honi chahiye: nitrogen se jure carbon par do methyl groups hain jo nitrogen ki taraf zyada electron density dhakelte hain. Paani mein napi gayi values taqreeban barabar hain (dono ka pKb taqreeban 3.3), kyunke ions ki solvation (paani se ghirna) bhi asar karti hai.

blocks.prompt: c) Propan-2-amine ka HCl se reaction dikhayein aur salt ka naam batayein.
d) Machhli ko sirke (vinegar) se treat karne par kaun sa acid trimethylamine se react karta hai? Equation likhein.
blocks.explanation: Ethanoic acid (sirke ka acid): (CH₃)₃N + CH₃COOH → (CH₃)₃NH⁺ CH₃COO⁻ (trimethylammonium ethanoate, jis ki boo nahi hoti).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne sawal (d) mein amine ka naam ‘N,N-dimethylammine’ likha hai. Machhli wali amine N,N-dimethylmethanamine (trimethylamine), (CH₃)₃N, hai, jaisa 24.3.1 ke ‘Did You Know?’ box mein likha hai.

items: Nitrous acid NaNO₂ + HCl se banta hai.
Primary: N₂ ke bulbule; secondary: peela tel jaisa N-nitrosoamine; tertiary: ghulne wala nitrite salt, koi nishan nahi.
